'''''Aporocactus''''' is a genus of [[Cactus|cacti]] in the tribe [[Hylocereeae]] native to [[Mexico]]. It used to be classified as a [[subgenus]] in ''[[Disocactus]]'', but according to molecular evidence, it should be excluded from ''Disocactus'' and treated as a separate [[genus]].<ref name=":0">{{Cite journal|last1=Cruz|first1=Miguel Ángel|last2=Arias|first2=Salvador|last3=Terrazas|first3=Teresa|date=2016-04-01|title=Molecular phylogeny and taxonomy of the genus Disocactus (Cactaceae), based on the DNA sequences of six chloroplast markers|journal=Willdenowia|volume=46|issue=1|pages=145–164|doi=10.3372/wi.46.46112|issn=0511-9618|doi-access=free}}</ref><ref>{{Cite journal|last1=Korotkova|first1=Nadja|last2=Borsch|first2=Thomas|last3=Arias|first3=Salvador|date=2017-11-03|title=A phylogenetic framework for the Hylocereeae (Cactaceae) and implications for the circumscription of the genera|url=https://www.biotaxa.org/Phytotaxa/article/view/phytotaxa.327.1.1|journal=Phytotaxa|language=en|volume=327|issue=1|pages=1–46|doi=10.11646/phytotaxa.327.1.1|issn=1179-3163|url-access=subscription}}</ref>

==Description==
It is an epiphytic genus growing on the branches of trees, but without parasitizing them. Occurs as drooping or creeping stems up to 60 cm with 6 ribs covered with many small spines.
